open_points.subject: A16 unknown-reference precheck vs A05 composition/proof
open_points.text: A16 rule 1: "A request naming a record that does not exist ... is refused as State 0's unknown reference before that record's own checks..."; A05 rule 1/7: proof phase 1 checks that "a function node names an existing contract version; an operation node names a binding in status accepted" and "Composition keeps any other flow version whether or not it is proven."
open_points.question: If a composed flow version references a missing contract version or binding, is the request refused as unknown reference (and no version kept), or is the version kept with an unproven ProofResult failure at phase 1?
options: Treat missing node references inside composed flow content as proof failures (version kept, unproven).
Treat any missing referenced record as A16 unknown reference before proof (no version kept).
open_points.default_guess: Treat missing references inside flow composition as proof failures so State 0 'kept either way' remains true.

open_points.subject: A08/A09 pre-send failure classification boundary
open_points.text: A08 rule 6: "fails one of rule 5's checks of the record itself — not those of the instance, which are A09 rule 6's own".
open_points.question: Exactly which A08 rule 5 checks are classified as "record itself" versus "instance" for runtime failure detail selection and precedence?
options: Define record-self checks as service file/capability/effect-class/invocability/idempotency declaration; define instance checks as selected instance/api_base_url/required_headers constraints.
Treat all rule 5 checks as binding-stale record checks at send time.
Split differently (e.g., path-shape or header-name conflicts treated as instance checks).
open_points.default_guess: Use the first split: record-structure/capability checks -> binding_stale; selected-instance/address/header-set checks -> A09 rule 6 instance details.

open_points.subject: A04 try-implementation case selection semantics
open_points.text: A04 rule 6: "executes ... on the cases ... that the request names, all of them when it names none".
open_points.question: Does an explicitly provided empty case list mean 'names none' (run all cases) or 'run zero cases' (and therefore refusal or empty result)?
options: Empty list means 'none named' => run all cases.
Empty list means 'named an empty set' => execute none (likely refuse).
Require field omission for 'all', reject explicit empty list.
open_points.default_guess: Interpret explicit empty list as 'none named' and run all cases.
